payload.notes: The Critic checked it against the GDD and sent it back: The top hat has two color areas, which is within the allowed range, but the design includes a band that may not align with the flat fill and thick outline style of the existing hats. (GDD: "A hat has one to three color areas that players recolor at Character Select."); The tall, flat-topped cylinder shape may not fit properly on the character's head due to its height and narrow brim, potentially causing misalignment or floating. (GDD: "Every item has to sit right on every character."); The top hat's design is too stylized and distinct from the simple, cartoonish flat shapes of the existing hats, breaking visual consistency. (GDD: "It has to look like it belongs with the four already in the game."). Simplify the shape to match the existing hats' flat, minimal design; ensure the brim sits flush on the head and the overall form reads clearly at game size.
